title: 51 ## 2-4 Disposal of cases by courts A total of 32,48,010 cases were under trial by the courts during 1974. This total included the cases pending from the previous year. Of the total cases, 0-7 per cent were either compounded or withdrawn. Trials were completed for 71-3 per cent of the cases.
